content: {"episode_id":"ep-05010","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) for this episode. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope (R55) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) and unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91). Per that note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring. Authorization status is missing, and we request review and payment of the outstanding balance of 773.19."}
